source: TU Darmstadt/data_sys_1.csv through data_sys_28.csv; Zenodo record 13715694 local extraction
metadata: count all lines using system wc; read first/last timestamp; sample every system across full byte span
sample_scope: stratified byte positions, contiguous rows within block; not uniform random independent rows
timestamp_duplicate_flag: zero seconds in adjacent sampled contiguous block
not_capacity_truth: SOC_Battery and I_CNV_Cell are field measurements/controls, not C/20 capacity labels
paper_relation: BattGP arxiv v3 says 29 systems; local Zenodo release 13715694 has 28; do not conflate formal published counts with local file count
